column3: NASB supplies “some”; “the escaped remnant” is rendered “who had escaped.”
“I beg you” is rendered “I beseech You,” and “keeps” as “preserves.” “Covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness.”
“This day” is rendered “now,” and “on the people” as “on behalf of the sons.”
“Surely we have acted corruptly” is rendered “We have acted very corruptly.”
“Your banished one” is rendered “those of you who have been scattered,” and “the end of the heavens” as “the most remote part of the heavens.” NASB supplies “though.”
“Fear” is rendered “revere,” and “give him to compassions” as “grant him compassion.”
